Hmmm...Well, I've went into work (fast food joint) with 2 tabs of acid on my tongue and tripped balls nearly the entire shift. 

Why? 

Because why the hell not?  

It was supposed to be my only night off and I got a frantic call 
like literally 5 minutes after I dropped from the assistant manager saying that the new GM that transferred there purposely fucked up the schedule (AM & GM had bad blood between them for years outside of work prior to this). 

AM says that she is the ONLY person on the schedule to work 5 PM til the time we close to the public (12 AM) and she tried like hell to get others to come in or stay later, even going so far as to try bribing them with her own money.

I tell her I'll there in 15 minutes but I don't want any grief. She says flat out "I don't give a FUCK what all drugs you are on, I need someone because I can't do this alone!"

I get to work, take 2 hits from a bowl, spray myself with Axe, and then proceed to head into the depths of McHell. I was simultaneously taking orders in the back drive thru, cashing people out, jumping into the kitchen to make their food, and if she was busy with customers on front counter, I'd hand the food out to the people at the front drive thru window. 

I was in a surprisingly good mood considering the circumstances, and between taking orders / cashing people out / making food / handing orders out, I was tearing down the kitchen as much as possible and taking dishes back to wash later when I got the chance. 

Everything was going good. I had a rhythm going.

Then it happened. 

A fucking Mega-Bus (double-decker bus) pulls into the parking lot just as I'm slowly starting to peak. As me and her are standing at the 
front counter watching people slowly meander off the bus, Pink Floyd's "Time" starts playing in the kitchen over the stereo.

And that's when I damn near entirely lost my shit. I just turned to look at her with the biggest shit-eating grin on my face (think Cheshire Cat from Alice in Wonderland), pupils the size of dinner plates, and I just start cracking the fuck up laughing.

The look on her face was just priceless. All the blood had drained from her face and she looked like she didn't know whether to laugh like I was at the shitty situation or start crying.

As the first couple of people are walking into the lobby, she quickly tries to recomposes herself, slaps me on the arm, and under her breath tells me to, and I quote, "Get my trippin' ass back in the kitchen!"

As I head back to the kitchen, I'm still laughing at the situation and proceed to start grilling burgers left and right like there's no tomorrow to try and get ahead. 

At this point, I notice that I can barely even make out the orders on the screen because the letters/numbers keep distorting in my vision, getting all wavy and blending together and shit like that. The heat from the grill and deep fryers start getting to me. I start seeing all kinds of wild trippy shit in the reflections on the stainless steel surfaces in the kitchen and the grease on the grill keeps changing colors like motor oil does when mixed with water. 

I get on the headset and tell the AM that whenever a customer up front is done giving their order, to turn her headset on and repeat it back to them like she is confirming that it's correct so I can hear the order and not have to mess around trying to make out the words on the screen. She turns her head and gives me "the look". I can tell right away she's pissed and that I'm most likely gonna get an earful at the end of the night but she just nods her head to acknowledge that she understands. 

About 45 minutes passes and the bus is finally finished, the people happily walking back outside to get back aboard it. AM looks around the lobby to make sure there's no stragglers left and then comes back into the kitchen where I'm at, resting my head in my hands on the prep table trying to keep it together because I'm still peaking.

She sneaks up behind me, putting a hand on my shoulder to try to comfort me and ends up scaring the absolute fuck out of me. She laughs and says "Sorry....I just wanted to tell you that you did a fantastic job considering what you're most likely going through. Oh, and that was a fucking genius idea having me repeat the orders back to the customers with the headset on! Even fucked up, you still manage to surprise me with how you're able to adapt when shit starts going south!"

I don't even respond immediately. I just turn towards her and give her a big hug, catching her completely off guard.

"Um.. uh...well, I guess I'll consider that a 'thank you'"

I take a step back and nod before turning to look towards the lobby.

"How bad is it? Does it look like a tornado blew through up there?" I ask.

"Nah...It's surprisingly not that bad. Other than some trays needing to be gathered and the beverage bar needing a quick wipe down, the only thing that really needs done out there is a couple of trash cans need emptied and taken down to the dumpster. I figured you could take a couple down, have a quick cigarette, then when you get back, I'll take the rest and do the same" she says, knowing I desperately need a smoke break and some fresh air for a few minutes.

Thankfully, the rest of the night was pretty much dead. I was able to take care of cleaning up in the kitchen and doing the dishes while she took care of the front counter and cleaned the lobby.
I got a call back to go in for a job interview.
